title: Control Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Controls Engineer / Sr. Controls Engineer** 




  





**Position Overview** 




 Looking for a
 **Controls Engineer / Sr. Controls Engineer / Automation Engineer** 
 with strong expertise in PLC programming, HMI development, industrial automation and commissioning.
 



 The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with
 **Siemens PLC and HMI programming** 
 , automotive assembly processes, robot integration and industrial automation systems.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and program
 **PLC and HMI applications** 
 .
* Test, validate and troubleshoot PLC/HMI software to ensure commissioning readiness.
* Develop operator visualisation screens using platforms such as
 **Weintek, AutomationDirect** 
 , etc.
* Support commissioning teams with technical troubleshooting and software\-related issues.
* Provide technical support to commissioning teams working in
 **North America** 
 .
* Prepare technical and non\-technical documentation as required for project deliverables.
* Support automation system standardisation and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Troubleshoot and resolve automation, controls and communication\-related issues.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary and remote engineering teams to achieve project objectives.



**Must\-Have Technical Skills** 



* In\-depth knowledge of
 **Siemens PLC and HMI programming** 
 .
* Hands\-on experience in programming and commissioning
 **robotic automation systems in the automotive manufacturing domain** 
 , particularly
 **BIW or General Assembly** 
 .
* Hands\-on experience in commissioning
 **automotive assembly processes** 
 , such as:
* BIW weld cells
* General assembly lines
* Strong knowledge of
 **PLC–Robot interfaces** 
 for applications including:
* Spot welding
* Arc welding
* Dispensing
* Projection welding
* Material handling
* Experience with industrial automation systems and commissioning.



**Additional Technical Skills** 



* Knowledge of
 **Industrial Networks** 
 , preferably
 **PROFINET** 
 .
* Knowledge of industrial safety standards.
* Experience with
 **Safety PLCs and Safety Relays** 
 .
* Knowledge of machine vision systems such as:
* Cognex
* Keyence
* Matrox
* Knowledge of
 **VFD and Servo Drive** 
 configuration and programming.
* Ability to read and interpret
 **electrical and mechanical drawings/layouts** 
 .
* Good knowledge of
 **pneumatic valves and circuits** 
 .
* Knowledge of offline robot programming using
 **FANUC, KUKA or ABB** 
 will be an added advantage.
* Basic programming knowledge in technologies such as:
* XML
* C\#
* JScript
* VBA
* Python
* will be an advantage.
* Experience in
 **plastic welding** 
 will be an added advantage.



**Educational Qualification** 



* Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in:
* Electrical Engineering
* Electronics Engineering
* Instrumentation Engineering
* Mechatronics Engineering



**Preferred Experience** 



* **5–12 years of relevant experience** 
 in programming and commissioning of robotic automation systems in the
 **automotive manufacturing domain** 
 , particularly
 **BIW or General Assembly** 
 .
* Experience with a
 **system integrator** 
 is preferred.
* Alternatively, candidates with strong experience in commissioning and troubleshooting automation systems in
 **automotive plants or similar industries** 
 may be considered.
* Experience in automotive manufacturing and robotic automation will be an advantage.



**Location Preference** 



* Candidates from
 **Kerala or Tamil Nadu are preferred** 
 , as this is a
 **work\-from\-office role based in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala** 
 .



**Key Competencies** 



* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Quick learner with strong functional and technical expertise.
* Ability to work effectively with
 **intercultural, multidisciplinary and remote teams** 
 .
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to organise, plan, prioritise and execute projects effectively.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a project team.
* Willingness to support international commissioning and project requirements.



**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




 The ideal candidate should be a hands\-on
 **Controls/Automation Engineer** 
 with strong Siemens PLC/HMI expertise and practical experience in automotive automation, robotic integration, commissioning and troubleshooting.
 



 Candidates who have worked with
 **automotive assembly lines, BIW weld cells, PLC\-robot communication, industrial networks and safety systems** 
 will be particularly relevant for this position.

title: Automotive Technician
description:
**Company Description** 
 MUTHOOT AUTOMOBILE SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED is an automotive services company headquartered at Muthoot Centre on Punnen Road in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India. The company operates within the broader Muthoot Group ecosystem, focusing on providing reliable and professional automobile solutions to a diverse customer base. It is positioned to serve both individual vehicle owners and business clients with a range of maintenance and repair services. Team members benefit from working in an established organization with opportunities to develop technical skills and contribute to high\-quality customer service.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Automotive Technician role based in Kanayannur. The Automotive Technician will perform routine vehicle inspections, diagnose mechanical issues, and carry out scheduled maintenance such as oil changes, filter replacements, and fluid checks. The role includes executing general automotive repairs, working on suspension systems, and ensuring all maintenance and repair work meets safety and quality standards. The technician will document work performed, maintain tools and equipment, and coordinate with service advisors or supervisors to provide clear updates and timelines for customers. The role also involves following workshop procedures, adhering to safety regulations, and supporting a clean, organized service environment.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong skills in Vehicle Maintenance and routine Maintenance \& Repair tasks.
* Hands\-on experience with Oil Changes and related periodic service activities.
* Proficiency in Automotive Repair, including basic mechanical diagnostics and correction.
* Knowledge of Suspension systems and ability to inspect, repair, or replace suspension components.
* Relevant technical certification or diploma in automotive engineering or vehicle mechanics.
* Ability to read and interpret service manuals, technical diagrams, and work orders.
* Attention to detail, commitment to safety, and ability to work effectively in a workshop team.
* Prior experience as an automotive technician or mechanic in a service center environment is preferred.
